reasoning: The codebase ALREADY has WiFi Direct (P2P) peer-to-peer connectivity fully implemented via WiFiDirectManager. The current issue is likely that WiFi Direct is not being properly prioritized or initiated when traditional WiFi is unavailable. This is a standard feature enhancement to ensure WiFi Direct P2P mode activates reliably for network-independent connectivity, not a complex architectural change.

scope.notes: Changes primarily in ConnectionCoordinator, MeshNetworkService, and WiFiDirectManager. The P2P infrastructure already exists - need to enhance connection fallback logic and ensure WiFi Direct group creation works when no WiFi network is available.

integrations.notes: No new external integrations needed. Android WiFi P2P API is already integrated via WifiP2pManager. May need minor research on WiFi Direct autonomous group creation for offline scenarios.

infrastructure.notes: No infrastructure changes required. All necessary permissions (NEARBY_WIFI_DEVICES, ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION, etc.) are already declared in AndroidManifest.xml.

knowledge.notes: Existing WiFiDirectManager has full implementation of peer discovery, group creation, and connection management. MeshNetworkManager handles the mesh protocol layer over established P2P connections. Pattern is clear and well-structured.

concerns: WiFi Direct behavior varies by Android device/manufacturer
Group owner negotiation timing in offline scenarios
Need to test on multiple devices without any network connectivity
Battery consumption with continuous P2P scanning
risk.notes: Risk is in device compatibility and edge cases when no network infrastructure is available. The core WiFi Direct APIs are mature and already integrated.

validation_recommendations.reasoning: Changes affect core connectivity logic which is critical to app functionality. Unit tests should cover connection state transitions. Integration tests should verify WiFi Direct group creation and mesh network establishment work when devices are not on the same WiFi network. No security concerns as this uses existing Android P2P APIs without new credentials or sensitive data handling.

likely_root_cause: The app currently relies on WiFi network broadcast for mesh discovery (broadcastDiscovery() uses subnet broadcast). When devices are not on the same WiFi network, this broadcast fails. WiFi Direct creates its own P2P network with its own subnet (typically 192.168.49.x), but the mesh network may not be automatically connecting over this interface.

implementation_direction.approach: Enhance connection flow to prioritize WiFi Direct group creation when no WiFi network is detected, and ensure mesh network properly utilizes the P2P interface for discovery and communication.
key_areas: Detect when traditional WiFi is unavailable
Automatically create/join WiFi Direct group in offline mode
Ensure mesh broadcast addresses include P2P interface
Improve group owner coordination for multi-device scenarios
